idea-plugin.name: Open Source in Editor Tab
idea-plugin.description:
Adds an Open Source in Editor Tab action to the Commit tool window and to the diff viewer.
  • Right-click a changed file in the Commit tool window: the action is the first menu entry.
  • In a diff tab: a toolbar button next to Collapse Unchanged Fragments.
  • Opens the real file in a normal editor tab, or focuses its tab if it is already open.
Source code and issues
